This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is an application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Naugaon P.S. Case No.213 of 2024 corresponding to Special G.R. Case No.80 of 2024 pending in the file of learned Addl.

District Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Jagatsinghpur, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.376(3)/295/506 of IPC r/w. Section 6 POCSO Act, on the allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim aged about 13 years.

3. Heard, Mr. Samvit Mohanty, learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr. A. Pradhan, Addl. PP and Mr.
Dharmendra Sethy, learned counsel for the informant in the matter and perused the record.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis-a- vis the accusations sought to be brought against him and regard being had to the nature and severity of the allegation levelled against the petitioner and the supporting materials collected by the Investigating Agency and keeping in view the presumption against the petitioner as available U/S.29 of the POCSO Act, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
